title: Big Time Gambling Boss: trailer vs full movie

commenti.body:
Final cuts which differ from trailers have always been a thing. Unfotunately that footage is probably sitting in an archive somewhere if it even still exists. 

Anyway, to pad out the word count, what did you think of the film itself? I thought it was decently entertaining but not even close to the masterpiece described by Paul Schrader and Yukio Mishima.
